findings.description: Decision 4's new closing sentence names decision 27 explicitly ("Reversed by decision 27"), but decision 27's own reversal note (around line 653, "This overturns a decision the hook contract had already recorded") names only CONTRACT.md, never "decision 4" — so the ADR's own stated convention ("A later one may reverse an earlier one; where it does, both say so") is only fulfilled in one direction. Not misleading, just incomplete.

The reworded wrapper-unwrapping bullet uses a curly apostrophe ("another runner’s payload") while every other apostrophe in this file is straight ('), a typographic inconsistency introduced by this edit.
